questions.question: In thousands of dollars, how much was awarded in lottery prizes in Florida in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_lottery_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='22Lottery', header=None)
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida']
result = int(str(row.iloc[0, 2]).replace(',', '').strip())

questions.question: Which three states generated the highest lottery sales revenue in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_lottery_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='22Lottery', header=None)
states_df = df.iloc[8:68].dropna(subset=[0]).copy()
states_df = states_df[~states_df[0].astype(str).str.contains('United States|Note|Last Revised', case=False, na=False)]
states_df = states_df[states_df[1].astype(str).str.strip() != '-']
states_df['sales'] = states_df[1].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').str.strip().astype(float)
states_df = states_df.sort_values(by='sales', ascending=False)
result = states_df.iloc[:3][0].str.strip().tolist()

questions.question: How many states did not operate a state-administered lottery in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_lottery_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='22Lottery', header=None)
states_df = df.iloc[8:68].dropna(subset=[0]).copy()
states_df = states_df[~states_df[0].astype(str).str.contains('United States|Note|Last Revised', case=False, na=False)]
no_lottery = states_df[states_df[1].astype(str).str.strip() == '-']
result = len(no_lottery)

questions.question: Between California and Texas, which state reported higher lottery administration expenses in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_lottery_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='22Lottery', header=None)
ca_admin = float(str(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California'].iloc[0, 3]).replace(',', ''))
tx_admin = float(str(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Texas'].iloc[0, 3]).replace(',', ''))
result = 'California' if ca_admin > tx_admin else 'Texas'

questions.question: Did New York have more than 3 billion dollars in lottery proceeds available to the state in 2022?

questions.question: In thousands of dollars, what were the combined lottery proceeds available in 2022 across California, Oregon, and Washington?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_lottery_finances_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='22Lottery', header=None)
target_states = ['California', 'Oregon', 'Washington']
subset = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(target_states)]
result = int(subset[4].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').str.strip().astype(float).sum())
